title: erigeron engelmannii var. davisii
intro: Erigeron engelmannii var. davisii, commonly known as Engelmann's daisy, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae) and is native to the southwestern United States. This plant is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally employed to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Engelmann's daisy include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Engelmann's daisy include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
